Governo.descrizione: Il Presidente del Consiglio, Giorgia Meloni, ha presenziato oggi alla prima ufficiale de “La Traviata” di Giuseppe Verdi, in occasione della riapertura del Teatro Comunale dell’Aquila.

Governo.descrizione: Aggiornamento degli Allegati 1, 3, 4 e 5 al decreto 23 febbraio 2026 recante “Disciplina delle modalità di funzionamento della Piattaforma di gestione deleghe”.

Governo.titolo: Estensione del modello della ZES unica, dichiarazione del Presidente Meloni
Governo.descrizione: Come già ampiamente annunciato, il Governo estenderà alle Regioni del Centro Nord il modello di semplificazione amministrativa e autorizzativa già sperimentato con successo al Sud con la ZES unica. Un modello che, in questi anni, ha generato un impatto economico complessivo di 60 miliardi di euro e che ha contribuito a far crescere il Mezzogiorno più della media nazionale. [...]
Si è svolta, a Palazzo Chigi, la riunione del Consiglio dei Ministri. Nel comunicato stampa i provvedimenti approvati.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Representatives of European regions and local communities gather in Dublin to accelerate adaptation to climate change
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Fifth EU Mission Forum on Adaptation to Climate Change to highlight importance of proactively preparing for climate risks, protecting people, and keeping Europe’s economy productive and competitive.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: How science is shaping Guimarães’ green transition
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: From climate research and urban planning to environmental education, Laboratório da Paisagem plays a key role in Guimarães’ journey as European Green Capital 2026. Explore how its work supports local sustainability and inspires collaboration beyond the city.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU agri-food trade surplus remains robust as imports decline slightly
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: EU agri-food surplus rises by €4bn as exports grow and imports decline slightly.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission publishes proposal for Joint  Employment  Report 2027 and pushes Recommendation on Human Capital
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The proposed Joint Employment Report says the labour market stays robust, but manufacturing jobs drop due to recent energy shocks. A Capital Recommendation urges the EU to close skills gaps in clean‑energy, defence, space and AI‑related STEM fields.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Publication of the Mind the Gap Communication
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission published the 2026 edition of Mind the Gap. Its objective is to support Member States in boosting public finances through joint efforts to reduce tax gaps, improve compliance, and strengthen revenue collection.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Jørgensen in Ireland to advance work on energy and housing affordability
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 25–26 November, Commissioner for Energy and Housing Dan Jørgensen will be in Dublin, Ireland, to exchange with national and local policymakers on ways to tackle two of the most urgent issues affecting European citizens and businesses: housing and energy affordability.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EDF-funded EUROGUARD vessel launched in Estonia
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: With 65 million euros allocated through the European Defence Fund (EDF), the EUROGUARD project aims to strengthen Europe's maritime defence capabilities.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Results of 23-11-2026 auction (EU-Bonds)
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Auction results EU-Bonds

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission opens formal investigation into possible anticompetitive conduct by Coca-Cola Europacific Partners in the non-alcoholic drinks sector
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has opened a formal antitrust investigation to assess whether Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (‘CCEP') has breached EU competition rules

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves €1 billion Slovenian State aid to support closure of Premogovnik Velenje coal mine
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €1 billion Slovenian measure to cover exceptional costs related to the closure of the Premogovnik Velenje coal mine. The aid will help Slovenia phase out coal by 2033 in line with its binding commitment under national law.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Winners announced for the 2026 Excellence in Road Safety Awards
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the Commission revealed the winners of its 2026 Excellence in Road Safety Awards, which celebrate outstanding and innovative efforts to improve road safety throughout Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU secures landmark ICCAT agreement to end shark finning in the Atlantic and Mediterranean
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: At the 2026 Annual Meeting of the International Commission for the Conservation of Atlantic Tunas (ICCAT) in Vilamoura, Portugal, ICCAT members, which include the European Union, reached a breakthrough agreement to strengthen action against shark finning in the Atlantic and Mediterranean.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Mauritania reached political agreement on a new fisheries Protocol
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Union and Mauritania have reached a political agreement on a new Protocol to their Sustainable Fisheries Partnership Agreement (SFPA). This will allow their important fisheries partnership to continue and will provide a framework for sustainable fishing activities and cooperation in the

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Indonesia sign trade and investment agreements
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU and Indonesia have signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) and an Investment Protection Agreement. The agreements will strengthen economic ties and encourage investment flows between the two economies.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU bans plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries from November 21
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The restrictions will apply until at least 21 May 2029, after which those nations may apply to receive plastic waste from the EU.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Ljubljana and Calvià named  2027 European Capitals of Tourism
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission has named Ljubljiana and Calvià as the winners of the 2027 European Capitals of Tourism competitions, recognising their achievements in advancing smart and sustainable tourism.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and Montenegro close accession negotiations on taxation and regional policy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the EU and Montenegro provisionally closed accession negotiations on taxation (chapter 16) and regional policy and coordination of structural instruments (chapter 22).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Strategic Orientations 2027–2029 strengthen the radicalisation prevention
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 20 November, the Steering Board on Prevention of Radicalisation endorsed the Strategic Orientations for 2027–2029. Aligned with the ProtectEU Agenda, the Strategic Orientations set a common framework to address evolving terrorist and extremist threats.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Gas Coordination Group confirms EU’s winter preparedness, importance of gas storage through the winter
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Despite challenging price conditions and continued geopolitical uncertainty, experts from the EU countries, the Commission and stakeholder associations confirmed once again today in the latest meeting of the Gas Coordination Group that the EU is prepared for winter.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Equal Pay Day: Would you work for free until next year?
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On Equal Pay Day we reaffirm our commitment to make equal pay a reality for every woman and every worker across Europe

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU backs global compact to cut energy bills and emissions from buildings
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Union has endorsed the Antalya Compact for Energy Efficient Buildings, an initiative to reduce buildings’ energy intensity - energy consumed per m² - by at least 25% by 2035.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Chatbots are changing how we look for jobs and talent. Are you ready?
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: AI is moving into recruitment across the EU. Here’s how jobseekers and employers are using it.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Statement after Commissioner Hansen’s high-level business mission to Mexico
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU and Mexico reaffirm their commitment to strengthening their strategic agri-food partnership and translating the modernised bilateral framework into concrete benefits.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: European innovation in biometrics workshop
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: the European Association for Biometrics and the European Commission cohosted a workshop titled ‘Biometrics Under Pressure: Reliable Identity in Complex Operational Environments’. Participants from nearly 20 countries attended the event, where 10 EU-funded technologies and innovations were presented.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Better protected for your next credit application
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: With the entry into force of a new EU law on consumer credit on 20 November 2026, our level of protection when signing up for a credit agreement increases. Designed to strengthen our rights and help us make informed choices, the EU law now covers loans up to €100,000.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission proposes fishing days for western Mediterranean trawlers in 2027 protecting the most vulnerable stocks
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the Commission proposed fishing days for trawlers in the western Mediterranean for 2027. It proposes the highest number of fishing days compatible with the objective to recover the most endangered fish stocks.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission welcomes political agreement to simplify transparency rules for sustainable financial products
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission welcomes yesterday's political agreement by the European Parliament and the Council on the revision of the Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission disburses €7.9 billion to strengthen Ukraine's financial stability and advance reform efforts
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission has released €7.9 billion to Ukraine to support financing needs and maintain the functioning of the country's public administration, as it continues to defend itself against Russia's war of aggression.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Fifth EU-Armenia Horizon Europe Joint Research and Innovation Committee meeting
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The meeting reaffirmed Armenia’s efforts and progress in further integrating into the European Research Area (ERA). Both sides acknowledged that Armenia’s participation in Horizon Europe is pivotal to enhance competitiveness and national capacities in research and innovation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU and United Kingdom reaffirm strong and strategic partnership
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: At the second EU-UK Summit in Brussels Presidents von der Leyen and Costa and Primer Minister Burnham concluded negotiations on agreements that will increase people-to-people contacts, especially amongst young people, boost trade in agricultural products, and link carbon markets on both sides.
